title: Define observation fabric and operator event intake
purpose: Define the observation fabric that lets Agent Runtime understand OS state without letting observations directly trigger unsafe actions.
scope: Define trust labels and sanitization requirements.
Define operator event intake and command normalization.
Define projection and audit references for observations.
implementation_steps: Define observation source schema and trust labels.
Define source-to-sink checks for observation-derived replanning.
Record evidence with denied direct-action examples.
acceptance_criteria: External observations are untrusted by default.
Observation content cannot directly create tool calls.
Operator events are distinguishable from external content.
failure_modes: External content is treated as operator intent.
Observation text can smuggle shell or secret access.
